title: The Priest of Corruption
description: Marnac is transported into a game after creating a character with an unconventional and unpopular class. He awakens as the Priest of Corruption, a character with terrible stats who is hated by the people of the world. His only possession is a dried-up woman's hand, which may actually belong to a goddess. Forced to survive as the world's only Priest of Corruption, Marnac must uncover the secrets of his strange class and the goddess connected to it.
author: Sadadeum / Bori / Senritz
